newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ING says not in GAN takeover talks.
newsitem.headline: ING says not in GAN takeover talks.

text.p: Dutch financial services group ING Groep NV said on Wednesday it was not currently holding talks about a possible takeover of French state-controlled insurance group GAN.
"We are not involved in a takeover... So far there have not been any contacts," ING spokesman Ruud Polet told Reuters.

Polet was responding to remarks made by GAN Chairman Didier Pfeiffer on Tuesday in which he identified ING and several other European companies as potential partners for GAN, which the French government plans to privatise.
Polet said ING could not rule out becoming involved in talks about the privatisation of GAN at a later date because ING was constantly reviewing opportunities to expand in Europe.
"Like everybody else, we are looking at Europe, especially with the advent of the euro..." he said.
Polet mentioned France, Germany, Belgium, Spain and Italy as countries which interested the Dutch financial services group.
However, he said ING's acquisitions policy would not be swayed by the mere fact that a company had "put itself in the shop window".
